title: Atlas dialectal de las laminillas oraculares de Dodona
description:
Interactive atlas of the Greek dialects attested in the oracular lead lamellae of Dodona, the digital companion to the PhD thesis Las variedades dialectales de las laminillas oraculares de Dodona (Universidad de Valladolid, in preparation). It covers the 4,418 texts of I.Dodone DVC and I.Dodone Lhôte, of which 1,455 carry dialect features, and presents for each dialect group its attribution criteria and degree of certainty, chronology, maps of place names and ethnics, linguistic features with the inscriptions that attest them, and the list of inscriptions, together with the notes of the author's autopsy of 71 lamellae.

The data are derived from the thesis chapters and research database by Python generators that check every figure against the database; the README explains how the atlas was built and how to read it. The interface is in Spanish.
